ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a cost baseline, deviation threshold and the missing-data flag are declared; it does not read real billing data.
offer: Compare cost with a stable baseline and an explicit deviation threshold. Missing billing input is a gap, never evidence that spending is normal.

minimal.reason: Declare the cost baseline anomalies are compared against. Without a stable baseline any figure looks normal, so record the reference period or amount.

mid.reason: Set the deviation threshold percent to at least 25. A tighter threshold alarms on ordinary variance, so choose a documented threshold of 25 or more.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring missing billing data to false. Absent billing input is a gap, never evidence that spending is normal, so surface it.

rule.reason: Declare the cost baseline anomalies are compared against. Without a stable baseline any figure looks normal, so record the reference period or amount.
